items.title: Bitcoin traders eye post-election rally as exchange outflows point to supply squeeze
items.summary: Bulls are watching short positions, exchange withdrawals and key price levels for signs of a rebound after the midterms.

items.title: Binance completes latest proof of reserves as it works to restore assets, withdrawals after record hack
items.summary: Binance users can now independently verify 1:1 backing for BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, XRP and more as it replenishes 95% of assets lost in record hack.

items.title: Bitmine adds 8,573 ETH as Tom Lee flags muted Binance hack reaction
items.summary: Bitmine added 8,573 ETH last week, lifting holdings to 6.06 million ETH, as Tom Lee flagged muted market response to Binance's hack.

items.title: Bitcoin eases to $77,900 as Binance customers pull $3.6 billion after withdrawals reopen
items.summary: Bitcoin fell 0.4% to around $77,900 since midnight UTC as Binance customers pulled a net $3.64 billion after withdrawals reopened and ETFs lost $643 million.
